question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**statute**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the one-child policy implemented in China in the late 1970s.
 
• The word in the blank should refer to an official rule or law.
 
• "**Statute**" is the most appropriate term as it means a formal written law enacted by a legislative body.
 
• Other options ("**standard**", "**average**", "**ordeal**") do not fit the context of an official policy.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *If we look at the global population, out of every six persons living in this world, one is an Indian and * *another__* * a Chinese. The population of Pakistan is very * *__small__* * and accounts for roughly about one-tenth of China or India. Though China is the largest nation and geographically * *__occupies__* * the largest area among the three nations, its density is the lowest. Scholars point out the one child * *__statute__* * in China in the late 1970s as the major reason for low population growth. They also state that this measure led to a * *__decline__* * in the sex ratio, the proportion of females per 1000 males.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Standard **(मानक): This refers to a level of quality or attainment and does not fit the context of an official policy.
 
• **Average **(औसत): This refers to the central or typical value in a set of data and is not suitable for describing a law or policy.
 
• **Ordeal **(कठिन परीक्षा): This means a painful or horrific experience, which does not fit the context either.
